metadata.question: Were black carbon AODs near the east of Australia, specifically within a 100km radius about (-34.344553, 157.706220), up during November 2019 to February 2020 in comparison to the same time the prior year?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI (Aerosol Index) or COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_CO (Carbon Monoxide) as proxies for black carbon. Actually, for black carbon AOD specifically, I should use MERRA-2 aerosol products or CAMS datasets. Let me check: ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI') has aerosol_index_340_380. For black carbon specifically, I should use NASA's MERRA-2: ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GSFC/MERRA/aer/2') which has BCSMASS (Black Carbon Surface Mass). - Actually, the most relevant is CAMS Global Atmospheric Composition Forecasts which includes black carbon AOD: 'ECMWF/CAMS/NRT' has black_carbon_aerosol_optical_depth_550nm or similar bands. - Let me use: ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/CAMS/NRT') with band 'black_carbon_aerosol_optical_depth_550nm' - Date: Nov 2019 - Feb 2020 vs Nov 2018 - Feb 2019 - Location: Point(-34.344553, 157.706220) with 100km buffer 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for aerosol products - Just need to check data availability 3. Logic: - Compare mean AOD between the two periods - If 2019-2020 > 2018-2019, answer A (Yes) - If 2019-2020 <= 2018-2019, answer B (No) - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([157.706220, -34.344553]); const roi = point.buffer(100000); // 100km radius const period1_start = '2018-11-01'; const period1_end = '2019-02-28'; const period2_start = '2019-11-01'; const period2_end = '2020-02-29'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Try CAMS first, then fallback to MERRA-2 let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/CAMS/NRT') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(period1_start, period1_end) .select('black_carbon_aerosol_optical_depth_550nm'); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/CAMS/NRT') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(period2_start, period2_end) .select('black_carbon_aerosol_optical_depth_550nm'); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (2018-2019) Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Period 2 (2019-2020) Images: ${size2}`); // Check if collections are empty if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { // Try MERRA-2 as fallback col1 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GSFC/MERRA/aer/2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(period1_start, period1_end) .select('BCSMASS'); col2 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GSFC/MERRA/aer/2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(period2_start, period2_end) .select('BCSMASS'); const size1_fb = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2_fb = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fallback - Period 1 Images: ${size1_fb}`); console.log(`Fallback - Period 2 Images: ${size2_fb}`); if (size1_fb === 0 || size2_fb === 0) { console.log('No data available for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean composites const mean1 = col1.mean(); const mean2 = col2.mean(); // 4. Check pixel counts const count1 = mean1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).values().get(0).getInfo(); const count2 = mean2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).values().get(0).getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 Valid Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`Period 2 Valid Pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean AOD values const val1 = mean1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).values().get(0).getInfo(); const val2 = mean2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).values().get(0).getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (2018-2019) Mean AOD: ${val1}`); console.log(`Period 2 (2019-2020) Mean AOD: ${val2}`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (val1 === null || val2 === null || isNaN(val1) || isNaN(val2)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (val1 < 0 || val2 < 0 || val1 > 10 || val2 > 10) { console.log('Values outside reasonable AOD range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const increase_pct = ((val2 - val1) / val1 * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Change: ${increase_pct}%`); if (val2 > val1) { console.log('Black carbon AOD increased in 2019-2020.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Black carbon AOD did not increase in 2019-2020.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
